commands: set -euo pipefail; git restore --source=HEAD -- dependencies.lock; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo '=== USBMODEM ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/tty.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -e /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 ]; then echo TARGET_PRESENT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101; else echo TARGET_MISSING=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101; fi
